name: Scene
brief: A class to composite children paints.
description: As the traditional graphics rendering method, TVG also enables scene-graph mechanism. This feature supports an array function for managing the multiple paints as one group paint.
As a group, the scene can be transformed, made translucent and composited with other target paints, its children will be affected by the scene world.
warnings: This class is not designed for inheritance.

members.name: add
members.signature: Result add(Paint* target, Paint* at = nullptr) noexcept
members.brief: Adds a paint object to the scene.
description: Appends a paint object to the scene. If the optional `at` parameter is provided, the paint object is inserted immediately before the specified paint in the scene. If `at` is `nullptr`, the paint object is appended to the end of the scene.

params.name: target
params.description: A pointer to the Paint object to be added to the scene. This parameter must not be `nullptr`.

params.name: at
params.description: A pointer to an existing Paint object in the scene before which `target` will be inserted. If `nullptr`, `target` is appended to the end of the scene. The default value is `nullptr`.

notes: Ownership of the `target` object is transferred to the scene upon successful addition. To retain ownership, call Paint::ref() before adding it to the scene.
The rendering order of paint objects follows their order in the scene. If layering is required, ensure the paints are added in the desired order.

members.name: paints
members.brief: Returns the list of paints currently held by the Scene.
description: This function provides a list of paint nodes, allowing users to access scene-graph information.
warnings: This is read-only. Do not modify the list.

members.name: remove
members.brief: Removes a paint object or all paint objects from the scene.
description: This function removes a specified paint object from the scene. If no paint object is specified (i.e., the default `nullptr` is used), the function performs to clear all paints from the scene.

params.name: paint
params.description: A pointer to the Paint object to be removed from the scene. If `nullptr`, remove all the paints from the scene.

members.name: add
members.brief: Add a post-processing effect to the scene.
description: Adds a post-processing effect to the scene's effect pipeline, which is applied after the scene has been rendered. Effects are applied cumulatively and in the order they are added. Calling this function multiple times will chain multiple effects sequentially.
Certain effects may be used to modify the pipeline behavior itself. For example, `SceneEffect::Clear` removes all previously added effects.

params.name: effect
params.description: The scene effect to add. Available effects are defined in the SceneEffect enum.
Additional variadic parameters required for certain effects (e.g., sigma and direction for GaussianBlur).

notes: The caller must provide the correct parameters for the selected effect. Supplying incorrect or insufficient arguments results in undefined behavior.

members.name: gen
description: This function allocates and returns a new Scene instance. To properly destroy the Scene object, use Paint::rel().
members.returns: A pointer to the newly created Scene object.

members.name: type
members.brief: Returns the ID value of this class.
description: This method can be used to check the current concrete instance type.
members.returns: The class type ID of the Scene instance.
